# Infinity SoftHub Technologies

> Infinity SoftHub Technologies is a founder-led Moodle™ and custom LMS development company in Faridabad, India, founded in September 2021 by Sadhna Yadav. It works remotely with schools, universities, training companies and corporate L&D teams in the USA, UK, Canada, Australia, Europe and Singapore. It builds Moodle, IOMAD and LearnDash platforms, custom plugins and themes, LMS mobile apps, SQL and Python coding labs, AI learning assistants and LMS integrations.

Moodle™ is a registered trademark of Moodle Pty Ltd. Infinity SoftHub is an independent development agency, not affiliated with Moodle Pty Ltd.

## Key facts
- Legal name: Infinity SoftHub Technologies (short name: Infinity SoftHub). Not related to similarly named companies such as "Infinity Softech" or "Infinity Soft Systems".
- Founder: Sadhna Yadav, Moodle and LMS developer, working with Moodle since 2019. Top Rated freelancer on Upwork: https://www.upwork.com/freelancers/sadhnay
- Founded: September 2021. Team size: 1-10.
- Office: Faridabad, Haryana, India (IST, UTC+5:30). Hours: Monday-Friday, 9:00-18:00 IST.
- Delivery model: remote projects, one direct point of contact, work tested on staging before release, clients own all custom code.
- Response time: replies to every enquiry within 24 hours.
- Pricing: fixed price for defined scopes, hourly for open-ended work, or a monthly support retainer. No licence fees for open-source Moodle.

## Core LMS services
- [Moodle Development Company & Custom LMS](https://infinitysofthub.com/services/moodle-all-development.php): Main service page. Custom Moodle builds, plugins, themes, integrations, upgrades, migration and support, with process, pricing models and FAQs.
- [IOMAD Multi-Tenant LMS](https://infinitysofthub.com/services/iomad-multi-tenant-lms.php): One Moodle site serving many companies or clients, each with its own users, branding and reports.
- [Enterprise LMS & Corporate Training](https://infinitysofthub.com/services/lms-solutions.php): Onboarding, compliance training, SCORM/xAPI, SSO, HR integration and manager dashboards.
- [LearnDash Development](https://infinitysofthub.com/services/learndash-development.php): WordPress LMS builds, course selling with WooCommerce or Stripe, memberships and custom plugins.
- [AI & ML Integration for LMS](https://infinitysofthub.com/services/ai-ml-integration.php): RAG course assistants, AI-assisted grading with teacher review, quiz generation and semantic search.
- [Mobile e-Learning](https://infinitysofthub.com/services/mobile-elearning.php): Responsive LMS, offline learning and iOS/Android apps connected to Moodle or LearnDash.
- [Moodle Setup, Hosting & Migration](https://infinitysofthub.com/services/hosting-migration.php): Hosting on AWS, Azure or DigitalOcean, version upgrades, migrations and backups.
- [LMS Security](https://infinitysofthub.com/services/security-solutions.php): Moodle security audits, hardening, MFA, SSO, backups and monitoring.
- [Interactive SQL Coding Lab (demo)](https://infinitysofthub.com/demos/sql-playground.php): Live browser SQL sandbox showing the coding labs built for Moodle and LearnDash courses.
